data.long_meaning: The name Pearce is an Old English name derived from 'Per' meaning 'son' and 'ceas' meaning 'bold'. This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and Normans, and is believed to have been borne by several early saints and warriors. The name Pearce carries the meaning “Son of the bold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Pearce usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the bold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
